_description: Licence register of every text under static/corpus/original and every frequency list under static/corpus/frequency: what it is, where it comes from, its licence, the attribution it requires, and whether Ergopti ships its n-gram tables (status ship), waits for the maintainer (hold) or must not ship them (refused), with the evidence. The layout analysis codegen (tools/codegen/codegen-layout-analysis-data-js.cjs) reads the licence and attribution of a built-in corpus from here, refuses to build one whose status is not ship, and refuses a text with no entry here. Audit of 2026-11-14, decided by the agent, to review by the maintainer.

frequency/leipzig/en_wikipedia_2016_1M.j.attribution: Leipzig Corpora Collection; D. Goldhahn, T. Eckart, U. Quasthoff (LREC 2012); Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA)
frequency/leipzig/en_wikipedia_2016_1M.j.note: Held for the maintainer (agent, 2026-11-15): the sentences are 2016 English Wikipedia text (CC BY-SA 3.0 before Wikipedia moved to 4.0 in 2023), but the Leipzig licence page answers automated clients with an anti-bot challenge (Anubis) and the archive carries no licence file; third parties cite older Leipzig releases as CC BY-NC 4.0. Only the counts ship (no sentence), n-grams rarer than 1e-7 of their table dropped (pruned_below). Ship it by setting status to ship and listing it in corpora.json.

frequency/lexique/fr_lexique_4_10.json.title: Character, bigram and trigram counts of the French word forms of Lexique 4.10
frequency/lexique/fr_lexique_4_10.json.attribution: Lexique 4 by B. New, C. Pallier, G. Schalchli, J. Bourgin and M. Gimenes (Behavior Research Methods, 2026), www.lexique.org (CC BY-SA 4.0)
frequency/lexique/fr_lexique_4_10.json.note: Licence read on www.lexique.org (« Lexique est distribuée sous une licence Creative Commons Attribution – Partage dans les mêmes conditions 4.0 ») and in the archive's README-Lexique.txt (« CC BY SA40.0 »), fetched 2026-11-15. Frequencies come from a 316-million-word subtitle corpus: spoken French. Each distinct form (1_Mot) counts once, weighted by the sum of its rows' frequencies per million (10_FreqMot, one row per lemma and part of speech) times 1,000, rounded; forms of weight 0 and the 290 multi-word rows (« citizen band ») are left out. The form total 11_FreqOrtho is not used: one form (« ben ») carries two different values of it. A word list: its n-grams are those inside words and at word boundaries, with no capitals, punctuation or letter pairs across words. N-grams rarer than 1e-7 of their table are dropped (pruned_below).
